comment: Both bend inputs are passed through an absolute value (Strings.cpp:463, Strings.cpp:675), so a negative voltage bends the pitch up just as a positive one does. A string the current fingering mutes is not silenced at the pitch output: it carries the chord's root a semitone below (Strings.cpp:686), and the mute gate is what marks it. The first string output and the first mute output become six-channel polyphonic cables only while none of their five companions is patched (Strings.cpp:661).
